verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an HTTP API, a Console CRUD API and per-endpoint API reference pages, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. llms.txt is a docs index rather than an API spec, and the human-readable reference pages do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
